description: This is a Java source file defining a REST API resource for managing Fixed Deposit Products in a financial application. It includes endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving (single and list), retrieving templates, and deleting fixed deposit product configurations. The class makes use of JAX-RS annotations for REST mappings, and Swagger annotations for API documentation. It ties into various services for persistence, security, and domain-specific data handling related to deposit products.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing Fixed Deposit Products, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and template retrieval, utilizing various domain services and annotations for documentation and request/response handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new Fixed Deposit Product. Accepts JSON input, constructs a command request, and returns the serialized result.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing Fixed Deposit Product identified by productId. Accepts JSON input and returns the serialized outcome.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all Fixed Deposit Products, with optional field filtering based on query parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve details of a single Fixed Deposit Product by productId, including charges, interest charts, and optional accounting details, with support for templates.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to provide a template Fixed Deposit Product data structure with various options filled in.

methods.name: handleTemplateRelatedData
methods.description: Private helper method to prepare template data for Fixed Deposit Product, gathering options for enums, currencies, charges, tax groups, and interest rate charts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a Fixed Deposit Product by productId.
